name: espnow-rx
description: Receive a Hapbeat ESP-NOW audio broadcast on any ESP32 board and play it out over I2S. No pairing, no ACK: every receiver on the transmitter's Wi-Fi channel hears the same stream, so the number of listeners is limited only by radio range. IMA-ADPCM modes work with zero dependencies; Opus modes are opt-in.
keywords: hapbeat, haptics, esp32, esp-now, espnow, audio, i2s, streaming, broadcast, adpcm, opus
